items.exampleEn: This old train runs on coal.
items.exampleZh: 這輛老火車靠燒煤行駛。

items.exampleEn: Beginners should ski on the easy slope.
items.exampleZh: 初學者應該在簡單的坡道上滑雪。

items.exampleEn: Bats sleep in caves during the day.
items.exampleZh: 蝙蝠白天在洞穴裡睡覺。

items.exampleEn: My boots were covered in mud.
The pond freezes in winter, and people skate on it.
items.exampleZh: 池塘冬天會結冰，人們在上面溜冰。

items.exampleEn: The truck carried the cattle to the market.
In the museum, there is a cup made from a horn.
items.exampleZh: 博物館裡有一個用角做成的杯子。

items.sentenceEn: We found a dark cave near the beach.
items.sentenceZh: 我們在海邊發現一個黑漆漆的洞穴。

items.audioEn: The cave tour starts at ten. Wear good shoes, because the path is full of mud.
items.audioZh: 洞穴導覽十點開始。請穿好走的鞋，因為步道上都是泥巴。
options: The tour is three hours long
The cave path is full of water
The way is wet and dirty

items.sentenceEn: In the past, people hunted animals for food.
items.sentenceZh: 以前人們獵捕動物當食物。

items.sentenceEn: The cattle are drinking from the river.

items.stemEn: The ____ ate grass in the field all day.
The children played by the ____ and fed the ducks.
items.stemZh: 孩子們在池塘邊玩，還餵了鴨子。

items.passageEn: My grandfather grew up in a small mountain village. In winter, people burned coal to keep their houses warm. His father was an experienced farmer who kept cattle, and my grandfather still has an old cow horn that his father used to call the animals. Near the village, there was a cave where children liked to play, and a pond where they swam in summer. When it rained, the slope behind the school turned into mud, and the children played in it for fun. Some men also hunted rabbits in the forest.
items.passageZh: 我爺爺在一個小山村長大。冬天時，人們燒煤讓房子保暖。他的父親是個有經驗的農夫，養了牛，爺爺到現在還留著一支他父親用來召喚牛群的舊牛角。村子附近有一個孩子們喜歡去玩的洞穴，還有一個他們夏天去游泳的池塘。下雨時，學校後面的斜坡會變成一片泥巴，孩子們就在泥巴裡玩。有些男人也會在森林裡獵兔子。

questions.questionZh: 冬天時村民怎麼讓房子保暖？
下雨時孩子們在學校後面的斜坡做什麼？

referenceEn: The horns of this cow are long.
rubricZh: horn 表示「角」，例如 long horns 等說法
